noticias.titular: Dodgers closer Diaz returns from IL, available for Giants series opener
noticias.texto: Los Angeles Dodgers closer Edwin Díaz has returned from a month-long absence due to a neck injury, making him available for Friday's series opener against San Francisco.

noticias.titular: Yankees' Aaron Judge returning to injured list with calf strain
noticias.texto: Three-time AL MVP Aaron Judge is headed back on the injured list -- this time with a right calf strain -- and Yankees manager Aaron Boone isn't sure whether the slugger will be able to return for the postseason.

noticias.titular: MLB playoffs 2026: Fatal October flaws for every contender
noticias.texto: Tired of seeing your favorite team go home early in the postseason? Here's one thing each current playoff team needs to address to make a deep run.

noticias.titular: MLB playoff picture 2026: Clinching scenarios, bracket, schedule

noticias.texto: The Dodgers clinched their fifth consecutive National League West title and 13th in the past 14 seasons with an 8-2 win over the Reds.
